scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BE,FE,MCP" -c "green,blue,yellow" "npm run start:dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run dev -w mcp-server"
scripts.db:generate: npm run prisma:generate -w backend && npm run prisma:generate -w mcp-server
scripts.db:deploy: npx prisma migrate diff --from-empty --to-schema-datamodel ./apps/backend/prisma/schema.prisma --script > ./apps/backend/prisma/schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute edustack_db --remote --file=./apps/backend/prisma/schema.sql
